artworks.title: Byloke, Ghent
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.description: The image depicts a winter scene with snow-covered buildings, including pointed steeples and ornate facades against a grey sky. The rooftops and ground are dusted with snow, and a wooden tub with a red cloth is in the foreground. Some cows are wandering on the snowy terrain, and in the distance, more buildings are visible with a few birds in the sky.

artworks.title: L'Abbaye St. Amand, Rouen
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.description: The image depicts a cityscape with buildings rising upwards. The brushstrokes are fine and detailed, capturing architectural features and figures. The color palette is soft and muted with earthy tones dominating. A group of people stand close by, some pigeons peck at the ground, and a stairway leads to a door with handcarts nearby. In the distance, more buildings and figures are visible, along with birds flying in the sky. The sky is pale blue with patches of cloud.

artworks.title: St. Séverin, Paris
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.description: The image shows a gothic-style church with intricate stone carvings and pointed arch windows. The church is the dominant structure, with people going about their daily activities in the foreground. The painting uses earthy tones and a detailed brushstroke technique to depict the scene realistically. The sky in the background is a soft blue with whispy clouds.

artworks.title: La Chapelle de l'Institut, Paris
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.description: The image shows an architectural scene. A building with a dome and classical columns is on the left, with other buildings extending towards a low horizon line. The artwork features detailed brushstrokes capturing the buildings' details. The color palette includes warm tones like ochre, beige, and browns, with dark accents. The sky is softly gradated. People in period clothing are scattered on the cobblestone area beneath the buildings.

artworks.title: Studies for Saint Michael Defeating the Rebel Angels
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over black chalk with brown, blue, and purple wash on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring angelic and demonic figures. The drawing includes angelic wings at the top and a dynamic scene below with a winged and armored figure wielding a sword, battling demonic creatures with bat-like wings. The composition captures the contrast between celestial and infernal realms, with a focus on movement and intensity. Light, shadow, detailed anatomy, and expressive gestures add drama to the scene.

artworks.title: View of the Ancient Port of Phaleron, Athens
artworks.artist: Jacques Philippe LeBas after Julien David Le Roy
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper [proof]
artworks.description: The image shows a lakeside scene with figures handling fishing nets beside a boat. In the background, there are hills and a small structure. A rocky landscape with an ancient stone building partially covered with vegetation is on the right. The illustration is detailed with a monochromatic color palette and a balanced composition.

artworks.title: The Dromos, Athens
artworks.artist: Jacques Philippe LeBas after Julien David Le Roy
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper [proof]
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape view from a slightly elevated perspective, overlooking a scene stretching into the distance. The horizon is above the center, with rolling hills, trees, and a cloudy sky. The sun partially obscured, casts rays from the top left. Detailed brushstrokes create a monochromatic palette with shades of gray. Figures are shown near ruins of classical architecture, with a waterfall leading to a river in the distance.

artworks.title: L'Optique (The Optical Viewer)
artworks.medium: etching and wash manner, inked à la poupée in black, brown, and green with hand coloring
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ivan E. and Winifred Phillips in honor of Margaret Morgan Grasselli and Andrew Robison
artworks.description: A woman and young boy stand in front of a square table set with papers and a looking device in this vertical, colored etched print. The boy and woman stand angled to our left at the center of the composition, and both have pale, nearly white-colored skin with wide-set eyes and delicate noses. Both smile with bow-shaped lips. The woman turns her face to look at us. Long blond hair is partially arranged in bands of curls under her forest-green hat, which has elaborate bows. The ultramarine-blue bodice of her dress fits tightly on the long sleeves and to the narrow waist. White fabric is gathered and tucked into the puffy neckline. Her pearl-white skirt flares out at the waist and falls in deep, crinkling folds to the ground. The woman reaches across the boy to hold the corner of one sheet of paper in the stack on the table. The boy has shaggy, dark brown hair, and he looks at the device. He wears a copper-orange jacket over a ruffled white shirt and blue pants. The hand we see rests on the edge of the velvety, terracotta-brown cloth covering the table. The wooden device is on a stand with turned knobs like a candlestick. A vertically oriented rectangular panel frames a round, blue-shaded window. A second panel hinges from the top edge of the first to angle up and to our left, presumably reflecting or mirroring images on the papers below. A brass and white stone candlestick and a glass cup sit on a brown stone mantle behind the table to our left. Those objects and the paneling of the room behind us are reflected in a mirror over the mantle. A chair upholstered with copper brown and with white trim stands behind the woman’s legs, and a stringed, guitar-like instrument leans against one arm of the chair. A teal-green curtain hangs from the top right corner of the sheet to drape across the back of the chair and partially cover a high wooden chest. An open book, a closed book, papers, and a white urn are arranged against the fawn-brown wall atop the chest. The floor is peanut brown.

artworks.title: The Dead Body of Christ
artworks.medium: mezzotint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a male figure in a seated position, with his head tilted back, obscuring his facial features. The figure has long hair and a muscular torso, defined arms, and legs. He is partially draped in cloth covering his lower body. Nearby, the outline of a crown of thorns can be seen on the ground. The background is a textured surface with soft shadows and highlights.

artworks.title: Funeral Procession on the Boulevard de Clichy
artworks.medium: color etching, drypoint, aquatint, roulette, and soft-ground etching, over heliogravure, hand-touched in watercolor and gold on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Helena Gunnarsson Buhot Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a street scene from an elevated perspective, drawn towards the horizon line in the middle of the image. Buildings populate the horizon, creating an urban environment. A moonlit sky with swirling clouds and birds fills the upper portion of the image. In the foreground, a carriage drawn by two horses is depicted with soft yet detailed brushstrokes, conveying movement. Figures in dark clothing walk or ride in a wagon further back, adding to the scene's dynamism. The color palette includes muted earth tones, shades of gray, and hints of violet in the sky. The style combines textured lines with looser, painterly strokes, suggesting both structure and fluidity.

artworks.title: The Marriage Presents
artworks.medium: pastel manner with ornamental borders drawn in pen and black ink, watercolor, and gold flocking
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a woman from the upper half of her body. She is angled slightly, facing the viewer directly. She has a gentle smile, bright eyes, and delicate skin. Her hair is styled in an elaborate updo with flowers, a ribbon or feather. She wears a pink dress with white lace trim, blue details, a low neckline, and a rose pinned to her bodice. She holds a small cameo or locket in her hands connected to blue beads or ribbon. The background is a soft blue fabric or curtain, and the portrait is encased in an oval frame with leaf patterns and blue embellishments.

artworks.title: Charms of the Morning
artworks.medium: pastel manner with ornamental borders drawn in pen and black ink, watercolor, and gold flocking
artworks.description: The image shows a young woman from the waist up, posed in a classic portrait style. She is slightly turned to the right, looking directly at the viewer with a gentle smile. She has a fair complexion, rosy cheeks, and an elaborate updo with curls falling around her shoulders. She is wearing an off-the-shoulder gown with lace details, and one hand is visible holding part of the gown. The background has a blue drapery with ornate patterns, and the portrait is framed in an oval with floral and leaf motifs and round beads.

artworks.title: Scaramouche Distracts Pantalon
artworks.artist: Johann Balthasar Probst after Johann Jacob Schübler
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of performers in a courtyard. The scene depicts an assembly of individuals involved in a lively act. One person is playing a guitar, surrounded by other figures engaged in animated gestures. Their attire consists of period costumes featuring elaborate patterns and textures. The backdrop includes classical architectural elements like columns and urns, creating an elegant setting. The drawing is detailed, using fine lines to create intricate textures and a sense of depth.

artworks.title: Harlequin at Dr. Polovard's House
artworks.artist: Johann Balthasar Probst after Johann Jacob Schübler
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of costumed figures in an elaborately decorated interior. The image shows a group of individuals with two figures in the front, engaging in a dramatic interaction. One figure is depicted in a dynamic posture with a flowing cape, while another character wears a pointed hat. A third figure looks on, and a fourth figure appears from the side drawing a curtain aside. The background includes intricate architectural elements like decorative columns, a staircase, and what seem to be astronomical instruments such as a globe and a telescope.

artworks.title: The Captain Regains His Freedom
artworks.artist: Johann Balthasar Probst after Johann Jacob Schübler
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a theatrical scene with masked performers engaged in a lively interaction. The image features a group of individuals, many of whom wear elaborate costumes and masks, seemingly in a theatrical performance or playful masquerade. The characters are engaged in various actions, such as brandishing flaming torches, raising swords, and gesturing dramatically. The setting appears to be a hall with architectural elements visible in the background, including an arched entryway, balustrades, and an open door through which more characters can be seen. The scene is dynamic and filled with energy. The detailed shading and fine lines suggest the drawing is an intricate work of art, capturing the facial expressions, postures, and clothing of the characters with precision.

artworks.title: Panorama toward Athens from the Garden of Aphrodite
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image is a pencil drawing featuring a panoramic landscape view of rolling hills. The horizon is high, showing distant mountains with a temple-like structure on a central hill. The drawing uses fine lines to depict terrain and vegetation details, with a monochromatic color palette emphasizing texture and form.

artworks.title: Old Cedars, Coast of Maine
artworks.medium: etching in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a tree in the foreground and the sea in the background. The tree has a twisting trunk and dense canopy. The land slopes towards the sea, creating a straight horizon where the sky meets the water. The artistic techniques include intricate lines and swirling strokes, with a monochromatic color palette of brown and sepia. In the background, more trees are seen against a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: New York Harbor
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The scene shows a waterfront setting with boats moored close to us against a backdrop of buildings. The horizon is in the middle of the image, where the line between water and sky becomes blurred by the distance. The sketch is executed in a fine etching style, with detailed and deliberate line work creating texture in the clouds and reflections in the water. The color palette is monochrome, focusing on varying shades of sepia. To the right, beyond the water's edge, there are rustic buildings with thatched roofs, stairs, and a mast with a flag. Sailboats are docked with their sails down, and other ships can be seen further in the distance, fading into the cloudy sky.

artworks.title: A View near Rome
artworks.medium: etching in black on Japanese paper
artworks.description: The scene is depicted from an elevated perspective showing rocky terrain in the foreground leading to distant mountains. The horizon is high in the composition with mountain peaks against a textured sky. The artwork features detailed etching techniques with fine lines capturing textures in the landscape such as grass, rocks, foliage, and architecture. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of gray and sepia. The image conveys a tranquil and timeless atmosphere with rocky formations, trees, a resting figure, and buildings in the distance, hinting at a village setting.

artworks.title: View from Tivoli across the Tiber Valley at Sunset
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with mountains in the distance, a dirt path with two figures on a donkey, rocky outcrops, trees, and a castle with a cylindrical tower. The scene has a detailed and precise brushstroke style, capturing the texture of foliage and rugged terrain. The color palette consists of greens, browns, blues, and whites.

artworks.title: Ruins of a Fortified Tower among Wooded Hills [recto]
artworks.medium: brown wash and watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Kurt Meissner
artworks.description: The image depicts an aerial perspective of a landscape. The horizon is high, showing a rolling terrain under a sky with light blue and soft beige clouds. A tall structure, possibly a tower, is in the foreground with sketchy tree outlines. Further back, there are brown patches indicating hills or cliffs, and more textured lines suggesting vegetation or structures. The color palette is muted with pastel tones and browns, and pencil lines are visible, giving the sketch a spontaneous, unfinished look.

artworks.title: Grove of Trees [verso]
artworks.medium: pen and black ink over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Kurt Meissner
artworks.description: The image features a sketch of a woodland scene. The point of view is from ground level, showing densely drawn trees that extend to the edges of the composition. The technique uses intricate pencil or ink lines to depict foliage and tree trunks, with a monochromatic color palette dominated by shades of sepia or light brown. Closest to us is a large, aged tree with a twisted trunk and sprawling branches. Other trees, less detailed, recede into the distance, creating depth in the image. The lines convey a natural setting.

artworks.title: Environs, Amiens
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.description: The image shows a rural scene with a dirt path stretching into the distance on the right side. A series of haystacks line the path, leading the eye towards a small farmhouse in the background. The sky above is overcast, blending into the land in the distance. The color palette is muted and sepia-toned, giving the image an antique feel. The photo has a soft focus and smoothed textures typical of historical photography.

artworks.title: Au Petit Dunkerque, 3 quai Conti
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a detailed architectural feature above an entrance. The image captures a wooden facade with a relief sculpture of a sailing ship with multiple sails. Below the ship is a horizontal panel with the inscription "AU PETIT DUNKERQUE." Additional ornaments with carvings of leaves and floral motifs surround the sculpture. Vertical bars or columns are visible to the right. Rich textures and shadows enhance the architectural elements.
